notes.title: Battletoads release lands today!
notes.notes:
Today's release brings a whole host of fixes and improvements to Battletoads! For the full list of what's in the update, please see below for the patch notes:


[b]TOP UPDATES[/b]

•	Balance changes to certain enemies and improvements to how the Invincibility Trigger can be used
•	es-ES and es-MX languages are now correctly displayed
•	Quality of life improvements implemented to address issues found across all platforms

[b]FULL UPDATES
[/b]
GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS

•	The ability to trigger Invincibility is now switched on by default on Toad difficulty
•	Invincibility can be triggered after 5 deaths rather than 8 on Toad difficulty
•	The time in which Invincibility can be triggered has been raised to 20 seconds in Toad difficulty
•	The length in which Invincibility stays active has been raised to 30 seconds in Toad difficulty
•	Increased the size of Axeley's hurt box in A Hard Axe To Follow, making it easier to hit them
•	Decreased the damage dealt from Maximum's projectile in So That’s How This Works
•	Decreased the damage dealt from Lumberjack Ranged's projectile in Stumped
•	Added extra time to Lumberjack Ranged's attack cooldown behaviour in Stumped
•	Updated the wording on the Game Completion screen to “Total Best Time”, to better explain how times are tracked on the player’s Save Game

[b]FIXED ISSUES[/b]

GAMEPLAY

•	Guardian boss can no longer soft-lock if cannister is hit back at them too early in Time For Plan B
•	Fixed issue where a soft-lock could occur if the player successfully completes and fails Bratty's stage at the same time in A Rock and A Hard Place
•	Stopped enemies from being able to leave playable space unless they are defeated in Show’s Over
•	Fixed an issue with puzzle colliders to avoid moveable boxes from getting stuck in Reaching The Peak
•	If player gets outside of playable space they will be teleported back into middle of the play space in A Hard Axe To Follow
•	Porkshank no longer gets stuck on the spot if a Toad tags out in Feed The Fantasy
•	Fixed camera issue to make it follow the correct target character in We Go High
•	Fixed collider on certain platforms to stop the playable character falling through in We Go High
•	Once the game has been completed, the Main Menu now shows "Continue" (which replays first level) rather than "New Game"
•	Removed a number of edge cases which cause the spikes to fall down at the end too early in Bigger Than It Looks
•	UI no longer shown during in-game cutscenes on Spaceship levels
•	Moveable boxes no longer move when they are not fully on platform in Reaching the Peak
•	Added the ability to use the invincibility trigger to Show’s Over and Dissed Topians
•	Riding close to holes in the walls no longer plays a near miss SFX in To The Queen
•	Topian laugh SFX will no longer loop during the outro cutscene in Nightmare Riders
•	PIA will no longer have a delayed static idle between their attack phases
•	Dead Toads no longer spawn during outro cutscene in Feed The Fantasy

LOCALISATION

•	es-ES and es-MX languages are now correctly displayed
•	Fixed incorrect translations of words and phrases in certain languages

PC SPECIFIC

•	Game will now use Windows display language instead of region for language choice
•	Game complete screen will now scale correctly at non 16:9 ratios
•	Fixed issues with ending cameras and aspect ratios in The Last Stand
•	Fixed animation flickers at start of final trial in Trials of Pummel Horse
•	Only process mouse interactions on the Main Menu if primarily using keyboard input
•	Fixed overlapping text issues in certain Settings tabs
•	Platforming levels now display correct control inputs on Pause Screen
•	In-Game Cutscenes on Spaceship levels should now be smoother on varying frame rates

[b]DOWNLOAD SIZES[/b]

ESTIMATED DOWNLOAD SIZES:

Steam: 4.00GB
